# GB sync
Date: 2026-11-20 | Duration: 36.349998474121094m

## Summary
The team agreed to retain weekly meetings, add attendees as needed, and bring Luke or another engineer into future calls to reduce technical back-and-forth. Cross-team alignment remains difficult because three or four teams have competing priorities during a peak workload period. Data plans include reconciling the existing Adobe pipeline with a direct Tealium-Snowflake path before switching, while verifying the established S3-to-Snowflake flow and Athena integration. Shaaz will share the architecture, and Rémy will correct the pipeline diagram. Checkout instrumentation is paused for this week and next week because the front-end team is unavailable; offline testing can use historical experiments and GrowthBook results. DPO guidance is still needed on consent and whether experiment-only data can use an essential-cookie treatment. Non-production work will begin in the acceptance environment after the front-end team returns, with launch timing uncertain around the last order day near December 15, the holidays, or early January. The team also discussed a low-risk AA test, flicker controls, experiment dimensions, fact-table joins, and unresolved order-versus-line-item data grain.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, Tealium, Adobe Analytics, Snowflake, Experiment instrumentation, Consent management
